_meta.name: California Pension Obligation Bonds (POB) Universe
_meta.purpose: Universe scoping for state_pension_intercept masking-mechanism validation. POBs are TAXABLE municipal bonds issued by CA cities/counties/special districts to fund a lump-sum payment to CalPERS / CalSTRS / county retirement system, hoping the agency earns more on bond proceeds (via pension portfolio) than the bond interest cost.

key_structural_facts.fact_1_state_of_ca_has_no_pobs: State of California has NO outstanding POBs. The 2007 State Pension Obligation Bond Committee validation action was REJECTED by CA Court of Appeal — court held the state's PERS funding obligation is voluntarily-imposed by Legislature on itself, so does not qualify for 'obligation imposed by law' exception to the constitutional debt limit. State POBs cannot be issued without 2/3 voter approval. Source: caselaw.findlaw.com/ca-court-of-appeal/1357288.html. The task-spec premise that 'State of CA has its own POBs (~$10B+)' is FALSIFIED.
key_structural_facts.fact_2_city_county_pobs_now_explicitly_l: California Supreme Court Dec 18, 2025 ruling in City of San José v. Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association unanimously upheld CITY/COUNTY POB issuance as falling within the 'obligation imposed by law' exception. POBs at the local-agency level explicitly permitted; validation actions no longer formally required. Source: orrick.com 2025-12 client alert.
key_structural_facts.fact_3_pob_security_is_general_fund: Per CA Debt Financing Guide §3.3.2.2: POBs are 'obligations issued by and payable from the general fund of a city or a county.' Unconditional, non-contingent obligations of issuer. NOT secured by ad-valorem taxing authority (unlike GO bonds). Subject to annual appropriation in practice but documented as non-contingent. Source: debtguide-api.treasurer.ca.gov.
key_structural_facts.fact_4_ch9_subordinate_to_pension: Stockton, San Bernardino bankruptcies established POBs are SUBORDINATE to pension contributions to CalPERS in CA Ch 9. Stockton POB bondholders received ~51% recovery (insurer Assured Guaranty made up shortfall); San Bernardino POB holders settled at 40% of par PV (from initial 1% proposal). CalPERS pensions paid 100% in both cases. Sources: Bond Buyer 'San Bernardino Chapter 9 Plan Gives Bondholders Worst Cut of All'; ABI 'Stockton Bankruptcy Settlement Preserves Pensions'. NOTE: Vallejo did NOT have POBs — task-spec premise that 'Vallejo had POBs in credit story' is FALSIFIED (Vallejo bondholder recoveries ~60% were on COPs and lease revenue bonds, not POBs).
key_structural_facts.fact_5_bond_insurance_role: Several CA POB deals were INSURED at issuance. Stockton 2007 POB ($125M) — insured by Assured Guaranty; insurer paid bondholders 100% despite Ch 9 haircut. San Bernardino 2005 POB ($50M) — insured by Ambac (Commerzbank Finance & Covered Bond was holder). This means the bond-insurance masking mechanism (agm_bond_insurance, similar BAM) intersects with state_pension_intercept on POB CUSIPs — a CUSIP-level test must control for wrap status.
key_structural_facts.fact_6_universe_size_taxable_market: California local-government POB issuance 1985 to April 2020: $25 billion+. 2020 + 2021 saw $7B in NEW issuance (peak of state's history) driven by Fed near-zero rates. Top 3 historical issuers by cumulative volume: Orange County $4.4B, LA County $2.9B, San Diego County $2.1B. Source: bondbuyer.com 'California pension obligation bond sales soared in 2020'. POBs are TAXABLE (not tax-exempt) — TEY math differs from CA AAA muni; alpha is computed against UST curve, not MMD.
key_structural_facts.fact_7_calpers_calstrs_funded_ratios_202: CalPERS funded ratio: 71.4% (FY2023) -> 75% (FY2024) -> ~78.6% est (FY2025 per preliminary 11.6% return announce). CalSTRS: 76.7% as of June 30, 2024 (unfunded $88.7B). Both improving but still 20%+ unfunded. Source: calpers.ca.gov, calstrs.com 2024 funding-plan reports.

universe_size_summary._methodology: Targeted 30-50 issuers per task spec; settled at 27 because (a) State of CA has zero, (b) only large/notable issuers warrant per-obligor record at scoping pass; smaller cities (Manhattan Beach, Larkspur, Novato, etc.) treated as a group residual.

_data_gaps_open: Per-CUSIP current bid-side spreads to UST (would require EMMA bulk pull or Bloomberg)
Pension funded ratio at obligor level not pulled for non-CalPERS/CalSTRS county systems (LACERA, OCERS, SDCERA, SBCERA, MCERA, etc.) — each has its own GASB 68 disclosures

obligors.obligor_name: State of California (General Fund) — POB validation rejected
obligors.rating_go: Aa2 / AA- / AA (Moody's / S&P / Fitch on State GO)
obligors.issuer_quality_signal: N/A — no POBs
obligors.recommendation: EXCLUDE — no investable POB CUSIPs at state level. The 2007 Court of Appeal ruling in State Pension Obligation Bond Committee v. All Persons (Cal. Ct. App. 2007) affirmed the trial court's invalidation of the proposed $929M POB issuance under the 2004 Pension Restructuring Bond Act. State POBs would require 2/3 voter approval.
obligors._notes: This entry is included specifically because the task brief asked about State of CA POBs (~$10B+) — a fact that has been ROUTINELY assumed by sector commentators. The factual record is the opposite: state POBs are constitutionally barred without voter approval. Worth catching as a fabrication-risk that prior agents could plausibly have produced.

pob_series_outstanding: Stockton 2007 Series A ($125M issued; current outstanding lower post-amortization)
obligors.rating_pob_2024_2025: Insured WRAP rating (Assured) — A range; underlying still sub-IG
obligors.issuer_quality_signal: Historical default — 2012 Ch 9 — POB recovery 51% direct + insurer top-up. Issuer credit weakness was REAL.
obligors.recommendation: EXCLUDE-ZONE — historical defaulter, post-emergence credit still weak. Bond insurance (Assured) is the only thing supporting current par; AGM masking applies. Cross-reference: agm_bond_insurance + state_pension_intercept ANTI-MASKING co-occurrence — POBs were SUBORDINATED in Ch 9, proving the intercept-masking thesis WEAKENS at the catastrophic-credit tail.
obligors._notes: POSITIVE CONTROL for masking-mechanism test. Stockton POB BK proves: at the catastrophic-credit tail, state_pension_intercept ANTI-masks (POBs subordinate to pension). The agm_bond_insurance wrap re-masks via Assured paying bondholders 100%. This is a co-occurrence of two masking mechanisms with opposite signs.

cross_obligor_observations.rating_dispersion_within_universe: Approximately AAA to BB- post-BK — 8-10 notch range, matching the charter and CCRC universe-spread (R^2 ~19% in charter). Sufficient dispersion to test descending-ladder thesis.
structural_factors_that_constrain_pob_ra: Taxable structure (no tax-exempt buyer base) — 1 notch typical
Subordinate to pension contributions in Ch 9 — 0-1 notch in stressed credits, 0 in strong credits
Lease-revenue variant (West Covina / Torrance) — additional 0-1 notch for lease-specific risk
issuer_quality_signals_to_track: Pension funded ratio at obligor level (CalPERS pool member vs own plan)
Structural vs cyclical deficit (Oakland is cyclical → structural)
Tax-base concentration (Imperial, Mendocino, Merced concentrated rural)
Auditor change history (covered by existing detector data)
EMMA material event filings (covenant tripwires, late filings)
